# tcs-format-narrated-deck

Builds the narrated-deck format of a lesson storyboard — one slide per scene with on-slide text in template props, full speaker notes, and voice-over, so the same storyboard renders to PPTX, an HTML slide lesson and a narrated slide video.

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../../README.md)** plugin. See its "which skill when" guide.

## What it's for
Produce a clean, accessible deck that a trainer can present live (speaker notes) or that plays as a narrated
video/HTML lesson (VO = narration). Best for policy, onboarding, compliance and reference-heavy lessons.

## When to use it
- Use when the chosen or requested format is "narrated deck", "slides", "PowerPoint", "presentation with voice-over", "speaker notes" or "instructor-led deck".
- **Not for:** animated explainers with B-roll (tcs-format-explainer) or one-page references (tcs-format-job-aid).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-format-narrated-deck <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

- Approved lesson (`curriculum.yaml`; `targets` usually include `deck`, often `lesson`/`video`/`scorm`).
- Facts from `sources.yaml` (decks/policies are the typical source — keep their structure where it is good).
- Theme preset + layout preset (`assets/theme_presets.yaml`, `assets/layout_presets.yaml`), voice (`assets/voices.yaml`).

**Outputs**

- `scenes[]` = slides, each a template: `title`, `section`, `bullets`, `icon_grid`, `steps`, `process_flow`, `timeline`,
  `comparison`, `do_dont`, `table`, `stat`, `definition`, `statement`, `checklist`, `quiz`, `image`, `outro`
  (+ mock-ups when demonstrating a screen).
- `narration[]` = voice-over **and** speaker notes (renderer writes narration text into PPTX notes).
- `scenes[].notes` = presenter-only notes (facilitation tips, questions to ask, timing) — not voiced.
- `on_screen_text[]` optional (derived if omitted) for alt text / translation.
- Fill-ins `templates/script_template.md`, `templates/speaker_notes.md`; fragment `templates/example.storyboard.json`.

## Examples
**Example 1: Executive deck**

Result: Slide-per-scene storyboard with speaker notes and voice-over.

```

```
